results.name: Retro Advertisement - Nintendo Nes from Kay Bee
results.description:
Hello everyone! When I read about the #RetroElectronicsChallenge, I couldn't help doing retro consoles! It was so much fun!

This is my entry for the challenge, a model inspired by a real advertisment from the shop Kay Bee. Ref: https://pin.it/6ooqrw5bevlxtg

I choose this reference because it make me feel so much nostalgic! Hope you all feel the same :)

Software: 3Ds Max, Substance Painter and Photoshop.

results.name: NES
results.description:
This was the first and most detailed of my Console series. I spent far too long on it. Once when I initialy modeled it and again when I started preping it for Sketch Fab and added every game I ever played as a kid to the scene. Feature creep at it's..best? Worst? You decide.


All Box art except the Mega Man 2 30th Anniversary box (i made that one) were made by: https://www.deviantart.com/m4rcusa
Most Cart Labels from: https://www.deviantart.com/deadly-rhythm/gallery

Both these artists specialize in Reproduction art, you should check out their respective galleries.

results.name: Super Nintendo Controller
results.description: The Super Nintendo Entertainment System (officially abbreviated the Super NES[b] or SNES[c], and colloquially shortened to Super Nintendo[d]) is a 16-bit home video game console developed by Nintendo that was released in 1990 in Japan and South Korea, 1991 in North America, 1992 in Europe and Australasia (Oceania), and 1993 in South America. In Japan, the system is called the Super Famicom[e], or SFC for short. In South Korea, it is known as the Super Comboy[f] and was distributed by Hyundai Electronics. The system was released in Brazil on August 30, 1993,[13] by Playtronic. Although each version is essentially the same, several forms of regional lockout prevent the different versions from being compatible with one another.
